templates.why_chosen: High-confidence matrix exemplar of two mirrored page-table rows, a guest chain above and a shadow chain below, cross-linked column by column by vertical arrows, with a dashed rule separating read-write region from read-only one.
templates.what_to_learn: Line up two parallel same-depth chains, real versus shadow or baseline versus protected, as two rows sharing identical column headers, and connect them with one vertical arrow per column instead of a tangle of diagonal lines, using one dashed rule to mark which side is mutable.

templates.why_chosen: Two full PGD-PUD-PMD-PTE table chains stack top (real, read-write) and bottom (CR3-rooted shadow, read-only), aligned column by column with vertical sync arrows crossing the dashed midline that is JANUS's actual integrity boundary.
templates.what_to_learn: Stack two identical multi-level structures, real above and shadow below, aligned column by column so vertical arrows can show exactly which levels sync and which do not, and mark the read-write versus read-only halves on either side of a single dashed midline instead of a caption note.
